summary: Recorded a persistence-mechanism behavior that a lost-save or duplicate-save defect would violate: inMemory.merge keeps savedTo consistent with truncation across append, below-marker replacement and middle replacement, so entriesToSave reports entries from savedTo+1 and entries removed by a conflicting append are re-reported as unsaved rather than treated as already persisted. Added the three source anchors for that accounting. No new question and no execution this turn.
